description: This file implements an OAuth2 authentication handler for Mattermost, defining the OAuther interface, its implementation, and related functions for managing OAuth2 tokens, URLs, and payloads within the Mattermost plugin system.

classes.name: OAuther
classes.description: Interface defining methods for OAuth2 authentication flow management.

classes.name: oAuther
classes.description: Implementation of the OAuther interface, managing OAuth2 tokens, URLs, and payloads.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of oAuther with specified configuration and options.

methods.name: NewFromClient
methods.description: Creates a new oAuther instance from a pluginapi client.

methods.name: GetConnectURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to initiate the OAuth2 connection.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth2 token for a given userID from the store.

methods.name: Deauthorize
methods.description: Removes the stored token for a userID, deauthorizing the user.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for OAuth2 connect and complete endpoints.

methods.name: AddPayload
methods.description: Stores payload data associated with a userID in the store.
